provider_query: Stack Overflow question on how to undo the most recent local commits in Git, and the command from the top answer
answer:
The Stack Overflow question is **[How do I undo the most recent local commits in Git?](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/927358/how-to-undo-the-most-recent-local-commits-in-git/)** (question 927358).

**Top answer command:** `git reset HEAD~` (default `--mixed`). It undoes the last local commit and leaves the file changes in the working tree, unstaged. The answer says to stop there if undoing the commit is all you want. [[1]](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/927358/how-to-undo-the-most-recent-commits-in-git/)

Related commands from that thread and common follow-ups:

1. **Accepted recipe (undo, then redo the commit):** `git reset HEAD~`, then edit, `git add .`, and `git commit -c ORIG_HEAD`. [[1]](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/927358/how-to-undo-the-most-recent-commits-in-git/)
2. **Keep changes staged:** `git reset --soft HEAD~1`. [[2]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE96YVNUOEdQcHU4a0JuUnlYbUM1alg0Yk9rNDFWZzUtTDJJcGRmOFE3Yy1LNHU2bmNfN2NtWlJxME9HTk1vTTdJc2UtZWx5ODJRdzM4YldWV01TYTVlenc?oc=5)
3. **Discard the commit and the changes:** `git reset --hard HEAD~1` (destructive). [[2]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE96YVNUOEdQcHU4a0JuUnlYbUM1alg0Yk9rNDFWZzUtTDJJcGRmOFE3Yy1LNHU2bmNfN2NtWlJxME9HTk1vTTdJc2UtZWx5ODJRdzM4YldWV01TYTVlenc?oc=5)
4. **Already pushed / shared history:** prefer `git revert HEAD` so history is not rewritten. [[1]](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/927358/how-to-undo-the-most-recent-commits-in-git/)
5. **Undo several local commits but keep changes staged:** `git reset --soft HEAD~N` (for example `HEAD~3`). [[3]](https://techearl.com/git-undo-last-commit)
6. **Recover a commit after a hard reset:** `git reflog`, then reset or checkout the old SHA. [[2]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE96YVNUOEdQcHU4a0JuUnlYbUM1alg0Yk9rNDFWZzUtTDJJcGRmOFE3Yy1LNHU2bmNfN2NtWlJxME9HTk1vTTdJc2UtZWx5ODJRdzM4YldWV01TYTVlenc?oc=5)
7. **Git Extras shortcut (if installed):** `git undo` (or `git undo 3` for three commits). [[1]](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/927358/how-to-undo-the-most-recent-commits-in-git/)
